sections.heading: C — Parking
sections.markdown:
## C — Parking

FACT_ID: sec09-F01 | anchor: A01
Badly parked cars roll, gather speed, wreck property, and kill, so every exit sets the parking brake, seats low, reverse, or park, kills the motor, locks the ignition, and pockets the key, with locking wise even at home [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec09-F02 | anchor: A01
Permitted highway parking signals and slows fully off the pavement or traveled way, breakdowns roll fully clear with flashers lit, exits mind rushing traffic, and children never approach oncoming lanes [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec09-F03 | anchor: A01
Angle entries scan ahead and behind for cars and walkers, signal and slow, confirm rear clearance past the parked car, then steer sharply in and straighten centered [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec09-F04 | anchor: A01
Angle exits confirm clear paths including lot carts, double-check both ways past blocking trucks and vans, creep back into clear lanes, tap horns for nearby walkers, and halt at the sightline past neighboring rooflines for a final all-around look [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0046]

FACT_ID: sec09-F05 | anchor: A02
Parallel parking stands legal at any unposted unyellowed curb within eighteen inches, and runs pick a roomy space, signal alongside the front car about two feet out, swing full left from front-wheels-to-their-bumper and back curbside within eighteen inches, check oncoming traffic, swing full right and back again, then straighten centered [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec09-F06 | anchor: A02
Parallel spacing punishes crowding the leader, early right cuts that graze the front bumper, wide standoffs that strand you from the curb, and late left cuts that strike the curb, with front ends swinging opposite the turn against neighboring cars, left-front-wheel-past-their-bumper marking the turn point, and every exit and backup signaled, watched, and slow [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec09-F07 | anchor: A02
Hills roll unbraced cars either way, so hill parking parallels within six inches of the curb, braces wheels per the curb rules, sets the brake, seats reverse, low, or park, and kills the switch [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0047]

FACT_ID: sec09-F08 | anchor: A03
Downhill bracing aims wheels at the curb and noses forward to contact in reverse or park, uphill-with-curb bracing aims sharply away and backs the rear tire to contact in low or park, and uphill-without-curb bracing aims sharply right so runaways flee traffic [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec09-F09 | anchor: A03
Hill starts fire the motor, seat the gear, signal, check mirror and rear, release the brake, recheck traffic, and claim a clear opening since through drivers own priority, with stick shifts feeding gas and clutch together against rollback [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0048]

FACT_ID: sec09-F10 | anchor: A04
Service Oklahoma hangs transferable mirror permits on physically disabled drivers or passengers for statewide reserved-space privilege, physician-completed applications prove the qualifying disability with a possible license review test, and false statements or unauthorized use earn a misdemeanor [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: sec09-F11 | anchor: A04
Parking stays illegal on sidewalks, before driveways, inside intersections, within fifteen feet of hydrants, on crosswalks, within twenty feet of intersection crosswalks, within thirty feet approaching roadside beacons, stop signs, and signals, within fifty feet of rails, within twenty feet of fire-station entries or seventy-five across properly signposted streets, beside obstructing excavations, double-parked off others, on bridges, elevated spans, and underpasses, and wherever signs ban stopping, excused only to dodge traffic conflict or obey law, officers, and devices [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0049]
